declarations.docstring: A type determined by a field and a natural-number index.
For indices greater than one, the displayed construction on the indexed type is the greatest element.
For positive indices, the kernel of multiplication by the designated element equals the range of multiplication by its predecessor power.
For positive indices, the kernel of multiplication by the predecessor power equals the range of multiplication by the designated element.
For indices greater than one, the range of multiplication by the designated element is not projective as a module.
For indices greater than one, the range of multiplication by the predecessor power is not projective as a module.
The designated element of the type indexed by a field and a natural number.
The index-th power of the designated element is zero.
Above index one, the square of the predecessor power of the designated element is zero.
For positive indices, the predecessor power of the designated element is nonzero.
